data.title: Chat: harden the AS-74 roster-title cascade guard — all: unset, native CSS nesting, orgNodeItem class set

data.body: Filed from the AS-74 review (Priya, M6 probes past the plan's list; none blocks AS-74 — all three are constructs style.css/app.js do not use today). Scope, three one-line-ish hardenings: (1) test/roster-truncation.test.js CONTRACT table has no 'all' row — appending '.roster-title { all: unset; }' resets white-space/overflow/text-overflow in a browser and T1 stays green (probe P6 survived, 6/0). Fix: ['all', [null]]. (2) The cascade parser silently mis-reads native CSS nesting: '#roster-list { .roster-title { white-space: normal; } }' appended — inner rule is swallowed by parseDecls as a garbage declaration, T1 green (P7 survived). Fix: throw in parseDecls/parseBlocks when a style-rule body contains '{', the same loud-failure choice the helper makes for :is/:where/:not/:has. (3) orgNodeItem has no complete-class-set pin (plan §10 offer): 'el("span", "org-extra")' inserted before the meta el() call reds nothing (P10 survived, api.test.js 62/0). Fix: a deepEqual class-set assertion over the orgNodeItem region using the AS-74 item-3 quote-agnostic regex. Predicted host count +0/+1; each fix gets its own named mutant (M4).
